messages.text: Month-end recon sign-off is due at 3. ReconLegacy EOD output is showing 3 wire breaks vs GLCore. Anyone know if last night's batch finished clean?
Priya Raman is the only one who can speak to the batch internals. I'll ping her. Kevin, can you check the GLCore side?

Two of the breaks look like timing. Wires released after yesterday's cutoff seem to be landing in today's GL batch. Roughly $412K combined.
Same pattern on the ACH side, one item for $18,250. Is it the cutoff, or is the job skipping records?
Can't answer that one. Cron schedule and the Oracle details live with Priya. I've DM'd her and asked her to reply in this channel.
Does anyone know when the ReconLegacy batch kicks off? Wondering if we can do a manual re-run before sign-off.
Not me, I've never touched those jobs. Please don't re-run anything until Priya says it's safe.
